figures.clock: original native IMU timestamps; elapsed display subtracts only the first timestamp
figures.sensor_response: actual model + applied residual physical inputs, forward first-order lag; exact native-interval ZOH
figures.sensor_response_initial_condition: conditioned on first raw reading; no sensor uncertainty band requested
figures.applied_torque: actual replay applied_residual_wrench_body columns 3:6; body coordinates about CoG; N m
figures.torque_uncertainty: no band requested; no replacement uncertainty computed
figures.trajectory_interpretation: caller-supplied reconstructions; writer performs no model replay, orientation update or substitution
figures.trajectory_uncertainty: unaltered supplied marginal covariance/factor; IMU attitude ±2 standard deviations retained; model position bands omitted by default, numerical arrays retained; not a 95 percent guarantee
figures.position_uncertainty: propagated covariance upper bound, retaining supplied parameter cross and declared unknown pose/history bounds
figures.attitude_uncertainty: native posterior-law local right-rotation covariance proxy; Euler first-order transformation
figures.attitude_display: unwrapped xyz Euler degrees, initially aligned only by integer full turns to the first displayed reference; native quaternions unchanged

reference.clock: original mocap timestamps cropped to native IMU support; no interpolation or extrapolation
reference.role: read-only black reference; never used to update supplied reconstruction
reference.uncertainty: no reference covariance supplied or fabricated

angular_carrier.use: body angular dynamics and its shared source factors; absolute free-model pose/position is not substituted for the observer state

observer_comparison.static_sensor_covariance: same isotropic trace(S)/3 I for both real-data branches
observer_comparison.gravity_only_covariance: existing native Bingham modal-curvature proxy unchanged

shared_model.interpolation: same native piecewise-linear residual mean/Jacobian; exact ZOH thrust response and actual-gimbal interpolation at all RK4 stages
shared_model.increment_factor: L_delta[k]=L_rotation[k]-D[k].T L_rotation[k-1]; original aligned31 source columns retained
shared_model.increment_covariance: L_delta L_delta.T / dt^2; first row is original initial model angular-velocity marginal
shared_model.independent_bingham_increment: explicit per-interval approximation of the shared-parameter angular carrier; source factor differences remain saved

mocap_use: initial conditions only in estimation; original supported rows for plot reference
